Name: Female Wizard (CP)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
There's not much to say about this one, it's what it says on the tin! Felt like making a female wizard portrait and then one thing led to another. Only changes the vanilla images, nothing else.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
